reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String shardRouting(String s){try{String[]p=s.split(";",-1);if(p.length!=2||p[1].isEmpty()||!p[0].matches("[1-9][0-9]*"))return null;int n=Integer.parseInt(p[0]);if(n>1024)return null;var o=new ArrayList<String>();for(String k:p[1].split(",",-1)){if(k.isEmpty())return null;int sum=0;for(char c:k.toCharArray()){if(c<32||c>126||c==','||c==';')return null;sum+=c;}o.add(k+"="+(sum%n));}return String.join(",",o);}catch(Exception e){return null;}}}
